recall_prompt: Say the definition of the angle between two planes, and then the formula that computes it from the two equations.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: State the definition
steps.margin_note: First mark. The words wanted are "the angle between their normals". Saying which of the two angles is taken finishes the statement.
steps.memory_tip: The angle between two PLANES is defined as the angle between their NORMALS.

plane and a normal to the second plane.
The angle between the two planes is defined
as the angle between these two normals.

recall.must_convey: That the angle between two planes is defined as the angle between their normals, and that the acute one is taken.
accept: the angle between two planes is the angle between their normals
draw a normal to each plane and measure the angle between them
the two planes make two angles adding to one eighty and the acute one is taken
rendu planes ki normals geesi vaati madhya angle ye answer
it is defined through the normals, not the planes themselves
reject: cos theta is the sum of the products over the two roots

steps.why: A plane has no single direction of its own, but its normal does. Defining the angle through the normals turns a question about two flat surfaces into the angle between two lines, which is already known from the previous chapter.
common_mistakes: Saying it is the angle between two lines drawn inside the planes, which is not fixed.
Leaving out which of the two angles at the intersection is meant.

steps.label: Write the formula in direction ratios
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The coefficients of x, y and z in each equation are the direction ratios of that plane's normal, so the line formula from the previous chapter is used with no extra work. The modulus keeps the answer acute.
steps.memory_tip: The coefficients of x, y and z ARE the normal's direction ratios, so the line formula is reused.

Then the angle θ between the planes is

recall.must_convey: That cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂| divided by the product of the two square roots of the sums of squares.
accept: cos theta is mod a one a two plus b one b two plus c one c two over the two roots
the coefficients of the two equations are the direction ratios of the normals
divide by root of a one squared plus b one squared plus c one squared, times the other root
coefficients ye normals ki direction ratios, formula apply cheyyali
the modulus keeps the angle acute
reject: the angle between two planes is the angle between their normals
heard_as: a one a two plus b one b two

steps.why: A normal points in two opposite directions, so without the modulus the same pair of planes could report the obtuse angle. The modulus is what makes the definition give one answer.
common_mistakes: Using the constant terms d₁ and d₂ in the formula, which do not affect the angle.
Leaving out the modulus and reporting an obtuse angle.
